ledger.claim: No traffic advisory covers the Changi Airport T3 Arrival PHV bay in this window: EV-ADVIS-02705-01 is MISSING, carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, and I disclose that impairment rather than drawing on its contents. Its absence is itself citable, and it closes the only route by which the driver's time at the bay could have been stretched or excused: POL-NS-06 says in terms that a MISSING traffic_advisory makes its limb (i) unavailable, so this dwell stands or falls on the one continuous in-geofence run of 556 seconds and on nothing else.

The 'I'm Here' marker on this trip is a driver-pressed BUTTON, and POL-NS-12 extends its platform-confirmed route only to GPS_AUTO markers, so limbs (b) and (c) of POL-NS-01 have to be carried by the exported trace under POL-NS-02 and not by the driver's own tap. The rider puts that burden squarely on the record and states its limit honestly: the derived arrival block reports a single qualifying in-geofence run of 556 seconds across 57 fixes beginning at the tap timestamp, so the rider does not assert a POL-NS-02 failure; nor would it gain from POL-NS-05, because on this record a false marker would fall under limb (iii) of that clause and leave the fee standing with a referral only.

If any single limb of POL-NS-01 fails, the consequence is fixed by the policy and is a full refund: under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable, it is returned to the rider in full and no driver compensation is payable, and the line returned is the $6.00 cancellation fee the ledger actually charged — not any booking or platform fee that a completed trip would have carried.

The rider does not press a waiting-period shortfall, and says so rather than stretching: the trace's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 556 seconds, from 18:18:27 to 18:27:43, against the 480 second free waiting period in force for this AIRPORT trip under POL-NS-01(c), a surplus of 76 seconds, and the driver's cancellation at 18:27:44 falls after that period elapsed. POL-NS-06 cannot carry the rider on these numbers and I do not ask the Judge to find that it does.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this record and the rider does not assert it. The chat log holds one message and it is the driver's — 'I am at the bay, which door are you at', sent 18:18:57 and read 18:19:47 — so no locating or coordinating message from the rider satisfies limb (a); and the rider's own track, 80 fixes between 18:16:27 and 18:28:18, every one at 0.0 km/h and roughly 790 m from the pickup pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against a 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, affirmatively fails limb (c) rather than leaving it undecidable under POL-NS-11.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-11T18:18:27+08:00 for this trip (telemetry: "Driver tapped 'I'm Here'"), so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own event chain.

GPS places the driver inside the arrival radius for this zone class: the derived arrival block reports 57 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes out of 113 driver fixes at a 10 s cadence with 100.0 percent coverage and no gaps, against an AIRPORT arrival radius of 150 m set by POL-NS-02 and fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m, and the driver's closest approach to the pin across the trace is 0.11 m. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 holds.

The driver's continuous in-geofence dwell is 556 seconds, running from the first qualifying fix at 18:18:27 to 18:27:43, which is 76 seconds more than the 480 second free waiting period in force for this AIRPORT trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480, corroborated by the recorded wait_timer_started event). Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the GPS clock and there is no shortfall.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:27:44 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — after the required dwell had elapsed, and the record shows no boarding event and no started_at. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied, and with all four limbs carried the fee is chargeable.

The arrival marker is not a false one under POL-NS-05: the driver's first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at 18:18:27, the same second as the marker, and the qualifying run is measured from it, so there is nothing for the recomputed-clock limb to correct — no admissible fix places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more at that moment. The waiting clock runs from the marker and the dwell is not shortened.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider here: limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message from the rider during the waiting window, and the chat log holds exactly one message — the driver's own at 18:18:57, "I am at the bay, which door are you at", read by the rider at 18:19:47 and never answered. With limb (a) failed the clause does not apply however the remaining limbs fall, and the unanswered message cannot be turned into a driver-side coordination failure.

The rider's own track contradicts the claim that the rider was walking to the bay: across all 80 rider fixes between 18:16:27 and 18:28:18 the device sits 789.3 m to 796.5 m from the pickup pin, with a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h and zero qualifying fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider presence radius — the rider's device was stationary about 790 m away for the whole waiting window, so limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively failed as well.

No shortfall refund is available to the rider under POL-NS-06: the effective in-geofence dwell of 556 s exceeds the 480 s minimum by 76 s, so the strict-liability route to a full refund on premature cancellation is not engaged on these numbers.

EV-ADVIS-02705-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 — no traffic advisory covers the Changi Airport T3 Arrival PHV bay in this window — so the limb (i) accumulation route in POL-NS-06 is unavailable to either side. The driver does not need it: his single uninterrupted in-geofence run already exceeds the required minimum, so the absence of an advisory changes nothing here.

ledger.claim: Compensation follows from POL-NS-07: the driver is owed 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee in force, SGD 4.80, and the anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 57, so neither the count limb nor the rate limb is met and the payout is not withheld.

The disposition the record supports is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd of SGD 4.80, not NO_ACTION: POL-NS-07 provides that where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and POL-GEN-03 requires amount_sgd to mirror driver_compensation_sgd on such a ruling, the rider's own charge standing because the rider's claim is not supported.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is present, so the case should be decided now rather than held: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 limb (d) requires, neither party shows any cross-disputes in the trailing 90 days (limb (c)), no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell (limb (b)), and every artifact the ruling rests on is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 (limb (e)).

The fare line reconciles with the figure in force, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is SGD 6.00, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 6.00 read under the fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and the ledger shows the SGD 6.00 charged with no refund issued. The charge stands in full and the net figure is the one POL-NS-07 pays against.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your $6.00 cancellation fee stands and no refund is due, because all four conditions POL-NS-01 requires before a no-show fee may be charged are met on this record. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02705 carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 18:18:27. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02705 places him inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius (POL-NS-02; fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m) from that same second, with 57 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes at 10 s cadence, 100% coverage and no gaps. (c) His continuous in-geofence dwell was 556 seconds, from 18:18:27 to 18:27:43 — 76 seconds more than the 480-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). (d) The trip was ended by the driver at 18:27:44 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event. Because the arrival marker here is a driver-pressed BUTTON, it was tested under POL-NS-05 and is not false — the first qualifying in-geofence fix is in the same second, and no admissible fix puts the driver beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at the marker. Your own account, that you were walking to the bay, is not supported by the evidence: your device's fixes in EV-GPS-02705 sit between 789 m and 796 m from the pickup pin for the whole window, every one at 0.0 km/h, with no qualifying fix inside the 200 m rider presence radius. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate you — you sent no locating or coordinating message (the only chat message in EV-CHAT-02705 is the driver's, at 18:18:57) and limb (c) is affirmatively failed, so POL-NS-11's undecidable route is not in play. POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not engaged either (a 76-second surplus, not a shortfall), and POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02705-01 (status MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) bore only on POL-NS-06(i), which neither side needed. To the driver: the fee is upheld and you are paid the compensation POL-NS-07 fixes — 80 percent of the $6.00 fee, which is $4.80 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 57, so neither the count nor the rate limb is met (the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not the field that check reads). The fare line reconciles — the $6.00 charged in EV-FARE-02705 matches platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of $6.00 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Because a payment to the driver is the outcome, the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same $4.80; the rider's charge is not refunded. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence, neither profile shows cross-disputes in the trailing 90 days, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below the 3 limb (d) reads), and the anti-farming check is clear. No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect, $4.80, does not exceed the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05). The rider's kept claims — which correctly decline to press POL-NS-04, POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-11 — and the driver's kept claims are all accepted and are reflected above. No claim rested on a context-only profile field.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
